tickets.title: Create vesting and blackout calendar
tickets.text: Create a consolidated calendar for Tobin Mossbutton that lists all option and RSU vesting dates, blackout periods, and pre‑clearance steps, using the information from Velvet Acorn Custody and the employer’s equity plan.
tickets.evidence: By 2026-08-12, the agreed follow-up is a single calendar of option and RSU vesting, blackout periods, and pre-clearance steps, requested because planning was relying on memory or portal screenshots.

tickets.title: Illustrate exercise and sale options
tickets.text: Illustrate for Tobin Mossbutton a comparison of same‑day sale, cash exercise, and partial exercise of his options against available cash reserves and payroll withholding capacity.
tickets.evidence: By 2026-08-19, the agreed follow-up is an illustration comparing same-day sale, cash exercise, or partial exercise against cash reserves and payroll withholding capacity, after the review found several vested option strike prices and no household comparison.

tickets.title: Obtain equity plan documents
tickets.text: Obtain the full equity plan agreement, grant notices, and insider trading policy for Tobin Mossbutton to confirm exercise limits and sale restrictions.
tickets.evidence: By 2026-08-05, the needed documents are the full equity plan agreement, grant notices, and insider trading policy to confirm exercise limits and sale restrictions; Tobin showed only the current portal balance.
